title: Research Analysts’ Price Target Changes for September, 13th (AAPL, ADTN, APTI, ATVI, CRBP, DRI, EVH, LINC, OXM, PGR)
text:
Research Analysts’ price target changes for Thursday, September 13th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target raised by Deutsche Bank AG to $205.00. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
ADTRAN (NASDAQ:ADTN) had its price target increased by MKM Partners from $21.00 to $22.00.
Apptio (NASDAQ:APTI) had its target price raised by Jefferies Financial Group Inc to $47.00. Jefferies Financial Group Inc currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Activision Blizzard (NASDAQ:ATVI) had its target price increased by Robert W. Baird from $81.00 to $85.00. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Corbus Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:CRBP) was given a $36.00 target price by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Darden Restaurants (NYSE:DRI) had its target price boosted by Argus to $240.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Evolent Health (NYSE:EVH) had its price target boosted by Canaccord Genuity from $24.00 to $28.00. Canaccord Genuity currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Lincoln Educational Services (NASDAQ:LINC) had its target price boosted by Barrington Research to $3.50. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Oxford Industries (NYSE:OXM) had its target price raised by SunTrust Banks, Inc. to $97.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Progressive (NYSE:PGR) was given a $64.00 price target by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock.
IMPINJ (NASDAQ:PI) had its target price increased by Piper Jaffray Companies from $26.00 to $31.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
Stryker (NYSE:SYK) had its price target raised by JPMorgan Chase & Co. to $200.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
VF (NYSE:VFC) was given a $105.00 price target by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Vistagen Therapeutics (NASDAQ:VTGN) was given a $6.00 price target by analysts at Maxim Group. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
